title: Design system tokens and UI copy guardrails

component_vocabulary.name: banner
component_vocabulary.anatomy: icon + title + optional description + optional action

states.name: Drives model
states.tooltip: Input is runtime-effective and directly affects calculation outputs.

states.name: Display only
states.tooltip: Field is visible for reference but does not currently affect runtime calculations.

states.name: Pending
states.tooltip: Field is planned or captured but not yet wired to runtime.

states.name: Needs review
states.tooltip: Field has ambiguous mapping, unresolved source issue, or validation concern. Requires review.

sub_reasons: Timing only — used for construction timing/draw schedule only
Reference only — shown for reference, not runtime-effective
Pending treatment — captured but treatment is pending
Pending runtime source — runtime source not yet connected
Not comparable — scope mismatch prevents comparison
Not applicable — does not apply to this project/scenario
Fixture-backed — value comes from a fixture CSV, not runtime solver
Frozen schedule — uses a frozen/scheduled value, not computed
Source locked — source is locked (e.g., Excel calibration)
Validation warning — has a validation concern
Excel parity known gap — known difference from Excel, documented
